text: 57-year-old male. The patient reports a large wound on his right lower leg that has been present for 6 months. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with Venous Leg Ulcer.

Based on the 6-month non-healing wound, history of DVT, chronic leg swelling, and family history, the clinical picture strongly points to venous stasis. The requested tests will confirm venous reflux and rule out infection or systemic inflammation.
